target.statement: XGBoost classifier with no feature selection achieves AUC 0.989 ± 0.01 in 10-fold cross-validation

compute.basis: No code released; must reimplement the paper's custom feature extraction (session grouping by cookie, payload/URL parsing into 78 features) and 10-fold CV with XGBoost on ~13.5k samples, which is CPU-feasible but the preprocessing reimplementation is the main time sink.

blockers: No code or configs released; feature extraction pipeline must be reimplemented from the paper's prose
Original CSIC2010 v2 dataset only available via a web.archive.org snapshot (link in paper), may need manual download
Exact hyperparameters (XGBoost settings, grid search ranges) not fully specified
title: Enhancing web traffic attacks identification through ensemble methods and feature selection
